newsitem.title: USA: TriTeal files for 2.1 million common shrs.
newsitem.headline: TriTeal files for 2.1 million common shrs.

text.p: TriTeal Corp said Tuesday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.1 million common shares.

Of the total, 1.35 million will be offered for sale by the company and 750,000 will be offered by the selling shareholders, the filing said. After the offer, outstanding shares will total 10,559,852 common.

The company granted the underwriters a 30-day option allotment to purchase up to 315,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through PaineWebber Inc, Hambrecht & Quist and Piper Jaffray Inc.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including working capital and capital expenditures, the company said in the filing.

TriTeal develops, markets and supports open systems-based, mission-critical desktop system software and integrated applications that enable multi-platform deployment of client/server applications throughout an enterprise.
